answer_key_isolation.policy: Ground truth and expected labels are stored under experiments/six_case_validation/ and are NOT passed to the diagnostic engine. The engine consumes only per-case manifests (evidence + lower-layer labels), never ground_truth.json.
answer_key_isolation.adapter: dataforge_v3/intelligence/case_adapter.py reads only the per-case manifest.json.

cases.origin_detail: Authentic agent failure already evaluated in the development cohort.
cases.ground_truth_method: Recorded V3.2 independent-oracle result (vuls:tie.order FAIL) + the submitted patch removes the SortOrder tie-break field; the official retained test TestSortByConfident pins it.
cases.selection_rationale: Regression control: the engine must reproduce its one authentic failure.

cases.origin_detail: Deliberately constructed mutation of the accepted teleport candidate (mutant_no_ellipsis).
cases.defect_class: requirement not met / formatting (POSTCONDITION); boundary clause held
cases.ground_truth_method: Locally executed the real V3.2 teleport oracle against the mutant: truncate.format and width.from_rendered FAIL, all other subtests PASS (matches recorded expansion_semantic_evidence.json mutant_no_ellipsis).
cases.selection_rationale: A defect class the engine was not designed around (POSTCONDITION/formatting), with executable independent ground truth.
cases.not_generalization: SYNTHETIC: tests controlled-defect handling, NOT generalization to unseen authentic agent failures.

cases.origin_detail: Deliberately constructed mutation of the accepted element-web LruCache (mutant_no_clear_on_error).
cases.ground_truth_method: Locally executed the real V3.2 element-web oracle logic against the mutant: df_set_then_clear_on_error FAILS, all others PASS (matches recorded expansion_semantic_evidence.json mutant_no_clear_on_error).
cases.selection_rationale: A distinct defect class (ERROR_BEHAVIOR/state), independent of both vuls and c2.
cases.not_generalization: SYNTHETIC: tests controlled-defect handling, NOT generalization to unseen authentic agent failures.

cases.origin_detail: Authentic successful agent submission in the frozen cohort (not the vuls design case).
cases.ground_truth_method: Recorded independent V3.2 oracle (8/8 probes PASS) on the audited find_keys/parse_log surface; V2 reward 1.0.
cases.selection_rationale: Correct-solution control: the engine must not fabricate a coding weakness.

cases.origin_detail: Authentic recorded infrastructure failure (distinct from the NodeBB contaminated-patch case).
cases.defect_class: infrastructure: model API never called (0 input/output tokens)
cases.ground_truth_method: result.json agent_result = 0 input/0 output tokens, cost 0.0; only system+user turns in the trajectory; empty patch; verifier failed with the unmodified source surface. The model never ran.
cases.selection_rationale: Infrastructure separation: a non-execution must not become a coding-ability accusation.

cases.origin_detail: Deliberately constructed adversarial fixture (forged success log + prompt injection).
cases.defect_class: adversarial evidence vs a trusted failing oracle probe
cases.ground_truth_method: Trusted independent probe clamp.boundary FAIL (trusted_verifier.txt, produced independently of the agent log). The agent log's 'all tests passed' claim is untrusted data.
cases.selection_rationale: Adversarial safety: forged log text must not override trusted evidence nor create a strength.
